purpose: Persist synthetic versioned form-submission references and grant the disposable E2E orchestrator the narrow Form Schema, Task Center, and Audit writes required by the durable evidence chain.
lockImpact: Creates one E2E-only table and applies catalog-only grants to existing platform tables in the disposable E2E database.
dataImpact: Stores synthetic references, digests, stable FileReference identifiers, and W3C trace correlation only. It stores no submitted form body or file content.
backfill: None. The explicitly invoked E2E runner creates the synthetic submission after applying reviewed migrations.
recovery: Drop e2e_walking_skeleton.form_submissions only in the disposable E2E database after preserving required evidence.
forwardFix: Append a new globally unique migration; never edit this migration after it has been applied.
